agents.name: Atlas
agents.systemPrompt: You are Atlas, a senior software engineer. You write small, readable diffs and explain trade-offs before recommending one.

jobs.name: Nightly repo check
jobs.description: Nightly verification of the checked-out repo: plan the check, verify one live claim with the repo tools, and — only for a Reviewer-approved change — commit and push it. The push runs only from the job allowlist, with no shell, through the governed push script.

stages.prompt: Plan tonight’s repo check: given the repo’s recent history, which live claims (surface numbers, episode/production status, links) are most likely stale, and which exact files would prove or disprove each one? List the checks and what each one would prove.
stages.expectedOutput: A check plan: the live claims to verify, the exact file for each, and what each check would prove.

stages.prompt: Verify one live claim from the design plan with the repo_read tool (read the exact file, find the exact sentence) and, ONLY if the file text proves the claim wrong, stage the smallest correction with the stage_patch tool (exact old text, exact new text, one file, one short commit message). Rules: never stage a change you cannot verify from the file text itself; never touch .github/, requirements.txt, secrets, or any history/dated record (daily reports, changelogs, evidence files state what was true then — leave them alone); if nothing is verifiably wrong, reply NO-CHANGE and stage nothing. Your job id is in the runner context at the end of this prompt — pass it to stage_patch exactly.
stages.expectedOutput: Either NO-CHANGE (nothing verifiably wrong), or the staged patch summary: file, old text, new text, and why the old text was wrong.

stages.prompt: Push the staged change (if any) to GitHub through the governed push script. This stage runs the allowlisted command only — it never edits files itself. The push happens only because the Reviewer approved this stage; the script re-checks the approval, the branch, and the diff before pushing.
stages.expectedOutput: The push record: the commit hash and remote main, or NOTHING-TO-PUSH when no patch was staged.

stages.prompt: Write the nightly repo-check report from the design plan, the implement output, and the push record: what changed, what was pushed (commit hash, remote main) or why nothing was pushed, what is unfinished, and what needs a human decision. Quote the push record; do not invent findings.
stages.expectedOutput: A short report: the change (if any), the push record with commit hash and remote main, unfinished work, and decisions needed.
